description: North Central Provincial Council - Governor declare that the third session of the Sixth Provincial Council of the North Central Province came to end on Midnight of November 10th, 2014 & Fourth session shall meet on 09th January, 2015
categorisation: This gazette content announces the conclusion of one session and the convening of another session of the North Central Province Provincial Council. It specifically deals with the scheduling and timing of provincial council sessions, which falls under electoral and legislative body processes. This fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns the operational schedule of an elected provincial council, which is part of the broader electoral and governance process.
